description: List / search chats (conversations). Optionally filter with a single field/operator/value clause (comparison AND), sort (e.g. chats.createdAt) with order, and paginate with limit/offset. HelpCrunch REST: POST /chats/search.

field.description: Field to filter on (e.g. customers.email, chats.status).

operator.description: Filter comparison operator (used with field + value).

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. chats.createdAt.

value.description: Value to compare the field against (used with field + operator).

name: helpcrunch_list_chats
title: List chats
